text:
ben_support: noticing a spike of 504s for hosted inference -> customer timeouts. multiple customers reporting failures in last 12m. escalating.
monitor_bot: ALERT: 5xx rate spike on /v1/generate (tenant: stripecorp). 504 rate 18% over 5m, baseline 0.7%. links: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/4234
cam_oncall: on it — can you paste a sample request id and any gateway logs? also confirm whether this is during a burst.
ben_support: sample request id req_0x7a9b. curl showed 504 and body "Gateway timeout". Happened right after a sudden traffic burst from a customer test harness.
alice_sre: quick check — do we see KEDA/ HPA events or pending pods stuck in ContainerCreating? that would indicate scale-up lag.
dina_eng: I noticed an operator change yesterday to the scaledobject pollingInterval and a new annotation that disables the "preflight" probe. might be related.
ben_support: scaledobject snippet from tenant namespace:

```
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: inference-queue-scaledobj
  annotations:
    keda.sh/pollingInterval: "60"
    redwood.com/preflight-probe-disabled: "true"
spec: ...
```
cam_oncall: that "preflight-probe-disabled" is new. if the runtime depends on a preflight readiness to prime caches (KV cache / model init), disabling it will let pods be marked Ready before they're actually warm — but also if readiness probe initialDelay is long, they won't be ready in time.
alice_sre: also check the runtime deployment readinessProbe - last deploy had initialDelaySeconds=120 for heavier models, which combined with KEDA polling=60s means scale decisions lag by minutes.
ben_support: reproducer steps (customer): 1) send 200 concurrent requests from same tenant 2) observe first 30s many 504s 3) after manual scale requests succeed. logs: "model init: waiting for kvcache primed" in pod init logs.
dina_eng: agreed — immediate fix: revert preflight-probe-disabled annotation, lower keda.sh/pollingInterval to 5, and set readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds=5 for builder image. I'll prepare a hotfix.
eva_cs: customer-facing note: "We're investigating elevated timeouts during traffic bursts and are applying a fix to improve scale responsiveness. We'll update in 30m." please share ETA once patched.
cam_oncall: performing manual scale now: `kubectl scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas=12 -n tenant-stripecorp`
output: deployment.apps/inference-runtime scaled
monitor_bot: METRIC UPDATE: 504s for /v1/generate dropped from 18% -> 1.2% in 4m, p95 latency down from 1.8s -> 420ms.
ben_support: closing loop for now. action items: (1) dina revert annotation + reduce pollingInterval (2) change readiness initialDelay to 5s in runtime image (3) postmortem with deploy checklist to catch preflight flag changes. tagging eng/runtime + eng-sre for follow-up :thumbsup:
